map.音乐练习计时器是做什么的？: What does Music Practice Timer do?
map.如何使用音乐练习计时器？: How do I use Music Practice Timer?
map.音乐练习计时器适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Music Practice Timer best for?
map.分段练习计时器，支持多阶段循环: Time music practice sessions and segments, helping you keep to a practice schedule and log the minutes.
map.分段练习总时长 = Σ 各段设定时长 × 循环次数 + 休息时长 ×（循环次数: Total segmented practice time = Σ each segment's set duration × number of loops + rest duration × (number of loops − 1); time remaining in a segment = segment duration − seconds elapsed; the count is driven by timestamp differences to avoid timer drift, each segment switches and alerts automatically when it ends, and it stops once the set number of loops is reached.
map.💡 练习时请保护听力，每45分钟建议休息5分钟。: 💡 Protect your hearing while practising; a 5-minute break every 45 minutes is recommended.
map.给音阶、曲目、视唱分设时段并累计，量化每日练习时长。: Set separate periods for scales, pieces and sight-singing and total them to quantify daily practice time.
map.音阶 10 min + 曲目 20 min，累计并记录。: Scales 10 min + pieces 20 min, totalled and logged.
map.可设段落循环计时。: You can set segment loop timing.
map.能记住上次练习时长吗？: Does it remember the last practice duration?
map.页面以单次计时为主，跨天累计建议手动记录或配合页面内日志，避免刷新后数据丢失。: The page focuses on single-session timing; for multi-day totals, record manually or use the in-page log, since data is lost after a refresh.
map.音乐练习计时器。日常生活工具，贴近生活，实用便捷。: Music Practice Timer. A daily-life tool that is practical and convenient.
